text: {"rules":[],"notes":"The document describes Cambridge Municipal Code Chapter 8.71 (Tenants Rights and Resources Notification Ordinance), which only requires landlords to give tenants an informational guide at the start of a tenancy and when steps to terminate it are taken. It expressly says it does not prevent evictions ('This Ordinance does not prevent a landlord from initiating an eviction action if otherwise allowed by law'), so it does not limit eviction to listed causes and is not a just_cause_eviction rule. It sets no rent increase limits, security deposit rules, application or screening fee caps, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent-setting rules. The only penalty mentioned ($300 per day) applies to the notification requirement, which is outside the six categories."}
